Readable.closed: `true` when the stream is no longer readable.
Writable.closed: `true` when the stream is no longer writable.
errored: The error the stream was destroyed with, or `null`.
push: Push `data` into the stream's internal buffer. If `data` is a string, it is encoded to a `Buffer` using `encoding`, defaulting to `'utf8'`. Push `null` to signal the end of the stream.
unshift: Like `stream.push()` but prepends `data` to the internal buffer so it is read before any already buffered data.
Readable.from: Create a readable stream from `data`, which may be a value, an array of values, or an async iterable.
Writable.write: Write `data` to the stream. If `data` is a string, it is encoded using `encoding`, defaulting to `'utf8'`. Returns `false` if the stream is backpressured. The optional `cb` is called once the write has drained.
Writable.end: Signal that no more data will be written. If `data` is provided it is written first. The optional `cb` is called once the stream has finished.
Writable.drained: Returns a promise that resolves once the stream has drained.
Duplex: A stream that is both readable and writable. Accepts the combined options of `Readable` and `Writable`.
Duplex.fromWeb: Convert a pair of web `ReadableStream` and `WritableStream` into a `Duplex`.
Transform: A duplex stream where output is computed from input.
Stream.duplexPair: Create a pair of linked `Duplex` streams. Data written to `a` is readable from `b` and vice versa. `options` are passed to each side.
Stream.pipeline: Pipe a series of streams together, propagating errors and cleaning up on completion. `streams` is a `Readable` source, zero or more `Duplex` transforms, and a `Writable` destination. Returns the destination stream. `cb` is called when the pipeline finishes or errors.
Stream.finished: Invoke `cb` once `stream` is no longer readable or writable, or has errored. Returns a function that detaches the listeners.
Stream.addAbortSignal: Destroy `stream` when `signal` aborts, using `signal.reason` as the destruction error. Returns `stream`.
Stream.getStreamError: Return the error a stream was destroyed with, or `null`.
ReadableStream: A web readable stream. `underlyingSource` may provide `start`, `pull`, and `cancel` methods, or be an existing `streamx` stream to wrap. `queuingStrategy` defaults to a `CountQueuingStrategy`.
getReader: Acquire a `ReadableStreamDefaultReader`. Throws if the stream is already locked.
tee: Split the stream into two independent `ReadableStream` branches.
pipeTo: Pipe the stream to a `WritableStream`, returning a promise that resolves once piping completes.
ReadableStream.from: Create a `ReadableStream` from an iterable or async iterable.
ReadableStreamDefaultReader: A reader over a `ReadableStream`, exposing `closed`, `read()`, `releaseLock()`, and `cancel([reason])`.
ReadableStreamDefaultController: The controller passed to `start` and `pull`, exposing `desiredSize`, `enqueue(data)`, `close()`, and `error([err])`.
WritableStream: A web writable stream. `underlyingSink` may provide `start`, `write`, `close`, and `abort` methods, or be an existing `streamx` stream to wrap.
getWriter: Acquire a `WritableStreamDefaultWriter`. Throws if the stream is already locked.
WritableStreamDefaultWriter: A writer over a `WritableStream`, exposing `desiredSize`, `closed`, `ready`, `write(chunk)`, `releaseLock()`, `close()`, and `abort([reason])`.
WritableStreamDefaultController: The controller passed to `start` and `write`, exposing `error([err])`.
TransformStream: A web transform stream. `transformer` may provide `start`, `transform`, and `flush` methods. Exposes `readable` and `writable` properties.
TransformStreamDefaultController: The controller passed to `start`, `transform`, and `flush`, exposing `desiredSize`, `enqueue(data)`, `error([err])`, and `terminate()`.
